stem:
Gita pours 150 cm³ of oil from a bottle into a wide bowl. The oil takes the shape of the bowl, but its volume stays 150 cm³.

Which statement explains this?

options.text: The particles in the oil are fixed in place and cannot move at all.
The particles in the oil can move and change positions while staying close because of the attraction between them.
The particles in the oil move freely in all directions and fill every part of the bowl.
The particles in the oil are far apart, so the oil can be squeezed into a smaller volume.

teacher.key_rationale: Liquid particles can shift within a limited space while remaining close under attraction, so the oil takes the bowl's shape but keeps a fixed volume.
